memory_update.text: The AI theme should remain structured as an infrastructure stack spanning compute, custom silicon, networking, optical interconnects, photonics, passives, advanced packaging/test, power, cooling, grid, and workflow software rather than a single GPU trade.
Optical EMS, photonics components, InP/photodetector capacity, and precision optical substrates are the highest-priority underfollowed AI infrastructure nodes in the current evidence set.
AI-server passive components, especially high-end MLCCs and board-level power delivery, deserve continued research as a second-order component-intensity beneficiary.

Data-center electrical distribution, switchgear, cooling, and grid-adjacent suppliers should be kept in the Layer 1 universe, but current candidate evidence is weaker and needs primary-source confirmation.
Layer 2 should prioritize primary-source validation for top optical and passive-component candidates before expanding lower-confidence hypotheses in power, thermal, advanced packaging, and software.
Later layers must test customer concentration, hyperscaler insourcing, capacity normalization, qualification failure, capex slowdown, margin compression, and valuation already pricing the bottleneck.

summary: Layer 1C merged the visible Layer 1A/1B AI universe into a deduplicated initial research universe centered on AI infrastructure chokepoints rather than only headline GPUs. Highest Serenity relevance currently clusters in optical interconnect manufacturing, photonics/InP capacity, precision optical substrates, AI-server passive components, custom AI silicon, advanced packaging/test, and data-center power/thermal infrastructure. The strongest directly supported candidates are Fabrinet, Lumentum, Coherent, Jabil, Applied Optoelectronics, Aeluma, Murata, and Broadcom. Additional public mappings are included as hypotheses where they fit the Serenity chokepoint map but still require primary-source validation. This output is a research-ranking universe only, not a buy/sell recommendation or valuation call.
